analysis: The change to docs/developer/test.md is documentation only. The patch updates the 'Last updated' date, rewords the CI runner description to reference build.md#ci-runner-routing, and edits a sentence about runner-routing tests (lanes per provider/cluster shard, release workflows on literal Blacksmith runners). The visible units (base lines 1846-2772) contain only unchanged surrounding test documentation; the changed ranges (lines 3, 1243-1247, 1807-1810) fall outside the supplied excerpts, so I relied on the patch excerpt. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption, key handling, cache storage, or wire-contract behavior changes. I found no regression against T-041 (prefix cache) or any other threat entry. A remaining integration question is whether the CI runner routing change (moving from literal Blacksmith runners to routed macOS runners for the ci.yml macOS jobs) affects the trust of the build or signing environment. That is a workflow change outside the supplied evidence; the docs only describe it, and release workflows are stated to remain on literal Blacksmith runners. The patch excerpt was truncated and the actual workflow or routing script changes were not supplied, so the routing's permission and fork-PR protections are unverified, but nothing here shows a weakened control.
